summary: Meta is now allowing rival AI companies to provide their chatbots on WhatsApp to Brazilian users for a fee, a day after the company confirmed a similar decision for users in Europe.

summary: Instead of relying on expensive management consultants, the startup uses AI voice agents to conduct interviews with customers of the companies the PE firms are considering buying.

summary: AWS is launching Amazon Connect Health, an AI agent platform that will help with patient scheduling, documentation, and patient verification.

summary: In an alleged drafted proposal, the U.S. government would play a role in every chip export sale regardless of which country it's coming from.

summary: The Department of Defense has officially labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk, making the AI firm the first American company with the label. Meanwhile, the DOD continues to use Anthropic's AI in Iran.

summary: Luma introduced Luma Agents, powered by its new “Unified Intelligence” models, designed to coordinate multiple AI systems and generate end-to-end creative work across text, images, video and audio.

summary: GPT-5.4 is billed as "our most capable and efficient frontier model for professional work."

summary: Called Automations, the new system gives users a way to automatically launch agents within their coding environment, triggered by a new addition to the codebase, a Slack message, or a simple timer.

summary: Winter Storm Fern showed that the integration of flexible resources paired with improved weatherization and better market structures can materially reduce risk during extreme weather, writes Tapas Peshin of PCI Energy Solutions.

summary: Total acres burned fell in 2025, but the Eaton and Palisades fires were hugely destructive and raise questions about the future of California's Wildfire Fund, one expert says.

summary: “Data center demand is hard to project over the next few years,” said Advait Arun of the Center for Public Enterprise. “In a market correction, it's very possible that data centers ... will end up crashing out of their tariff arrangements.”

title: Washington, California and Québec collaborate on linking carbon markets
summary: The three jurisdictions released a draft agreement this week that would add Washington to the largest carbon emissions trading market in North America.

title: Clean energy deployment alone doesn’t raise rates: CATF
summary: Data shows that renewable standard portfolio and net-metering programs can raise rates, but clean energy deployed outside of these programs has no discernible impact, said the Clean Air Task Force.

title: AI is outpacing America’s power grid. Nuclear must become a national priority.
summary: Nuclear power can scale with the needs of AI, writes Amentum’s Mark Whitney. Companies and communities relying on renewables will risk outages, higher costs and missed opportunities.

title: Tariff refunds: Court provides first step with liquidation order
summary: The Court of International Trade on Wednesday directed Customs and Border Protection to remove defunct tariffs when finalizing non-liquidated entries.

title: PJM market monitor opposes Maryland power plant sale to data center company
summary: TeraWulf’s plan to buy a power plant from GenOn faces opposition at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission as hyperscalers at White House meeting pledge to bring their own generation.

title: NRC approves construction of advanced nuclear reactor in Wyoming
summary: The construction permit to a subsidiary of Bill Gates’ TerraPower for a 345-MW commercial nuclear power plant project is the NRC’s first commercial reactor construction approval in nearly 10 years.

title: Utilities lack tools to guard power grid from drone attacks
summary: Power grid asset owners and operators have growing concern around their ability to protect critical assets from drone attacks as the U.S. government warns energy companies to prepare for possible Iranian retaliation.

title: Kairos, DOE enhance collaboration on advanced reactor design
summary: The US Department of Energy's Oak Ridge National Laboratory and Kairos Power have entered into a USD27 million strategic partnership to accelerate the technology needed to deploy a new generation of advanced nuclear reactors.

title: Reactor vessel installed at Lufeng 6
summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been hoisted into place at unit 6 of the Lufeng nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province. It is the second of two HPR1000 (Hualong One) units under construction at the site, where four CAP1000s are also planned.

title: Contract signed for generic Polish BWRX-300 design
summary: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy and Orlen Synthos Green Energy have signed an agreement to develop a detailed technical design of the BWRX-300 small modular reactor adapted to Polish regulations, safety standards and environmental conditions.

title: New heat-resistant steel developed for BR-1200
summary: Rosatom says a new austenitic steel has been developed for the primary circuit of the planned lead-cooled BR-1200 reactor where the operating temperature will be 500-600 degrees Celsius.

title: Lloyd's Register approves hybrid powered ship design
summary: UK-based classification society and professional advisory service Lloyd's Register has issued approval in principle to Australian ship design group Seatransport Pty Ltd for a concept of a hybrid nuclear-diesel powered ship.

title: Lithuania assessing potential for BWRX-300 deployment
summary: Poland's SGE, Ignalina Nuclear Power Plant operator Altra and GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to assess the potential for BWRX-300 small modular reactors in Lithuania.

title: 'Transformative' research reactor mooted for Texas A&M
summary: The Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station has signed an agreement with advanced small modular reactor company ZettaJoule to explore building a very-high temperature modular reactor that could attract USD1 billion in research funding.

title: Potential sites identified for SMRs in Chernobyl exclusion zone
summary: The State Agency of Ukraine for Exclusion Zone Management has said that sites by two long-abandoned villages have been identified as potential locations for future small modular reactors.

title: First concrete for Kaiga 5 & 6 in India approved
summary: India's Atomic Energy Regulatory Board has given its consent for the first pour of concrete for Kaiga units 5 and 6 - which are both 700 MWe pressurised heavy water reactors.

title: Largest module installed at second Lufeng unit
summary: The CA20 module - measuring about 20 metres in length, 14 metres in width and with a height of 21 metres - has been hoisted into place at the second unit of the Lufeng nuclear power plant in Guangdong province.

title: First concrete poured for new capacity at Kaiga in India
summary: The first pouring of concrete marks the point at which a project becomes a nuclear power unit under construction - the aim is for the first new unit at the Kaiga nuclear power plant to achieve criticality in five years.

title: Potential for CANDU units in Turkey to be explored
summary: Candu Energy and Türkiye Nuclear Energy Company have signed a memorandum of understanding to assess the potential for the deployment of Canadian CANDU reactor technology as Turkey looks to expand its nuclear energy capacity.

title: South Korea to cooperate with the Philippines on nuclear power projects
summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power, the Export-Import Bank of Korea and the Philippines' largest private electric distribution utility Manila Electric Company have signed a tripartite memorandum of understanding for cooperation in developing nuclear power plants in the Philippines.

title: Aalo secures fuel and turbine for experimental reactor
summary: Aalo Atomics, a US developer of sodium-cooled small modular reactors for data centres, has signed a fuel fabrication contract with Global Nuclear Fuel. Meanwhile, Baker Hughes has been contracted to supply the steam turbine for Aalo-X, Aalo's experimental reactor.

title: NRC issues construction permit for first Natrium plant
summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has approved a construction permit for TerraPower's Kemmerer unit 1 project - the first such permit for a commercial-scale non-light water reactor in the country for four decades.

title: The Chukotka icebreaker's emergency diesel generators tested
summary: The nuclear-powered Chukotka icebreaker is equipped with emergency diesel generators with a rated output of 250 kW. The launch of the generators is part of the mooring trials for the vessel.

title: Research aims to bring MSRs closer to commercialisation
summary: Researchers from the University of Liverpool and Copenhagen Atomics say that salt purity is the critical factor in preventing corrosion of stainless steel in molten salt reactors. Meanwhile, irradiation testing of materials for such reactors has begun at the High Flux Reactor in the Netherlands.

title: Haiyang 3 completes cold tests
summary: Cold functional tests have been completed at unit 3 of the Haiyang nuclear power plant in China's Shandong province, State Power Investment Corporation has announced.

title: GBE-N granted licence to generate electricity
summary: Great British Energy - Nuclear has been granted an electricity generating licence - required by all electricity generating companies - by the UK's gas and electricity markets regulator Ofgem.

title: Mini drones used to explore Fukushima 3 reactor
summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company has begun its internal investigation of Fukushima Daiichi unit 3's primary containment vessel, using palm-sized micro-drones.
